results.title: The River's Bend
results.overview: Among images of a utopian everyday life, the Paranaíba river tries to understand why Anair is so afraid of its depths.

results.title: Love Is Blind: The Reunion
results.overview: After the weddings, the Pod Squad from 'Love Is Blind: Ohio' shares relationship statuses and receipts in this tell-all reunion special.

results.title: Wilder
results.overview: Focusing on the life and legacy of actor Gene Wilder, told through the lens of Jordan Walker-Pearlman, the late actor’s nephew and a filmmaker in his own right.

results.title: The Moonlight Murders
results.overview: An investigative reporter gets an exclusive interview with a key witness to the latest in a series of serial killings. Little does she know, her new interview suspect harbors a dangerous obsession.

results.title: Family Drill
results.overview: A director returns to his childhood home to recreate, with actors, the argument that drove his parents apart when he was four years old. Through improvisation and a film shoot that reveals his own artifice, he builds memories to which he never had access. But as the scene repeats itself, the indications lose their clarity and the border between reconstruction and desire start to blur.

results.title: Superbloom
results.overview: Visual album of the sixth studio release by the English singer Jessie Ware.

results.title: Nakabinbin
results.overview: A widowed father must secure a death certificate to bury his daughter, only to learn that without proof she was ever born, the law leaves him no choice but to break it.

results.title: The Manor: First Encounter
results.overview: At the turn of the century, a Manhattan family’s move to an Upstate New York hamlet inadvertently awakens an extra-terrestrial force that torments the community.

results.title: Purgatory
results.overview: In the early 1980s, 13-year-old Beatrice Gravel's comfortable world—family, school, and church—fractures when her mother moves out to 'self actualize', leaving Beatrice and her younger sister Chloe with their devastated father. As Beatrice doubles down on a plan to 'fix' her family, she barrels through bullies, friendship blowups, a make-out party, and a kleptomaniac babysitter—forcing her to decide who she wants to be when she can’t get what she wants.

results.title: Broken Rice
results.overview: An international student far away from home finding comfort in broken rice.

results.title: Enough is Enough
results.overview: January 2025, the city of Goma, capital of North Kivu in the Democratic Republic of Congo, falls into the hands of rebels. It took only four days for the M23 to defeat the DRC army, the armies of Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Malawi, South Africa, Burundi, mercenaries, and militias, under the watchful eye of the largest UN base, MONUSCO. ENOUGH IS ENOUGH bears witness to the incredible vitality of the Congolese people as they grapple with the indescribable tragedy of an endless war in North Kivu, DRC.

results.title: My God, My Country
results.overview: Objects collided or something had broken apart, rather than collided, and indeed, they were very homogeneous, approaching slowly, in a calculated manner. This signaled some kind of war, a threat of war. We should have been the ones to report on this war.

results.title: ABBY
results.overview: Two young people realize that there's more to life than each other.

results.title: Outposts: Nothing Here is Yours
results.overview: Outposts have become a major tool for taking control of land in the occupied West Bank and displacing Palestinian communities. These communities face escalating daily violence, threats and when they simply can’t take it anymore – displacement. Over 60 Palestinian communities have been displaced since October 7. Israeli activists come in daily shifts, armed only with their phones, to document, confront settlers, and stand in solidarity as the Palestinian communities struggle to remain on their land.

results.title: October Shadows
results.overview: Two years after the attack of 7 October 2023, Israeli survivors and bereaved families confront psychosocial trauma and attempt recovery on a daily basis. Through intimate stories and quiet observation, the film examines facets of grief and resilience, focusing on the long aftermath rather than the moment of violence. It offers a humane portrait of loss, memory, and the difficult path toward healing.

results.title: Good Vibes Only
results.overview: A woman desperately wants to cry following a painful breakup. But her AI companion won't let her.

results.title: Horatio Gould: Space Cowboy
results.overview: Horatio's sophomore comedy show. Recorded at the Hoxton Hall, East London 29/11/25.

results.title: Tua Tua Keladi
results.overview: The quiet lives of elderly residents in a small fishing village are turned upside down when the Health Department announces that exposure to the chemical P172 triggers a dramatic surge in libido. Amid the panic and awkwardness, the villagers must navigate their suddenly chaotic relationships, reawakened by newfound passion.

results.title: The Gold Trail
results.overview: Fafner, a mercenary anti-hero, descends upon a city torn by conflict, relentlessly tracking a trail of coins that will lead him toward his inevitable fate.
